verdict.justification: Deliverable A is substantially more thorough, operationally sound, and closer to an audit-ready SOP package for a biotech organization. In the SOP, Deliverable A Follows the exact section ordering requested in the reference material (Procedure as Section 5, Change Criteria as Section 6, Approval Logic as Section 7), whereas Deliverable B splits Roles & Responsibilities and RACI into two sections and swaps the order of Procedure and Change Criteria. More importantly, Deliverable A provides actionable operational frameworks where the source notes were high-level—such as a concrete 1–5 Risk Assessment Scale with descriptors (Table 6.3), a detailed Classification Rules table (Table 6.2), and a comprehensive Decision Matrix (Section 7.3)—while still transparently logging these additions in Section 9 (Assumptions and Open Items). Deliverable A's Change Request Form is also far better designed, featuring separate, unambiguous signature tables for Fast-Track (Section F1) vs. Full Review (Section F2) and explicit Change Criteria screening checkboxes, whereas Deliverable B combines both paths into a single table that is more prone to user error. Finally, Deliverable A includes an approval signature block on the SOP cover page and a detailed instructions tab in the Excel tracker.
